name: EPIC 220487200
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.5 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220487200 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.458034 (16th-84th percentiles 7.194424-7.741213), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220487200 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.963086 (16th-84th percentiles 0.882798-1.053498), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220487200: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4810.629 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220487200 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4348.046875 (16th-84th percentiles 4221.367188-4481.679688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,348 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.96 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,811 K at its surface.
